hypotheses.justification: The proof never uses this hypothesis; the leading underscore already marks it as unused. The whole proof is the term `AlgebraicCurve.pathIntegral_finset_sum_smul F hF ι s c θ γ hreg hprim`, which takes only `hF`, `hreg` and `hprim` (plus the data arguments). `_hregsum` is not mentioned in the conclusion or in any other binder. If it is deleted, the same term still proves the theorem unchanged.
